title: CTAM cycle state and readiness
description: The 'data' payload of GET /cycle. Reports host-wide cycle progress and the caller's own readiness. ctam_ready is host readiness and does not imply the caller's requirements are met; a module must read requirements_satisfied for that.

analysis_time.description: The requested analysis time for this cycle, not wall-clock now. Identical in real-time and historical execution.

state.description: Host cycle state. Mirrors the plan's state machine exactly.

ctam_ready.description: True only after the catalog is frozen, current stormcells are in memory, and every StormProb base requirement has been evaluated. Does not imply every optional source exists.

requirements_satisfied.description: Every required selector for this caller resolved to a ready artifact. Optional selectors do not affect this value.

allowed_operations.description: Which operations the host will currently accept from this caller. Empty means read nothing and write nothing.

historical.description: True when replaying an archived cycle. The API model and pinned catalog are identical either way; this exists so a module can label its own output.

cell_count.description: Number of cells in the current working snapshot. Zero is legal and produces no patchable cells.

deadline.description: Absolute UTC time at which the host will terminate the caller. Derived from the manifest timeout bounded by the limits document.
